sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。

related.title: Massive MIMO：固定總功率的陣列增益
related.titleEn: Massive MIMO: array gain at fixed total power
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 1280 microsecond 與 320 microsecond，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 1280 microsecond and 320 microsecond, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋12.0411998266 dB與18.0617997398 dB，建立array_power.csv、正規化推導、相位誤差圖，並完成以下驗收：15 dB理想增益門檻由64元通過；實際驗收仍需方向圖與旁瓣，不能當全方向增益。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 12.0411998266 dB and 18.0617997398 dB; create array_power.csv, normalization derivation and phase-error plot; apply this acceptance decision: Only64 elements exceed15 dB ideally; acceptance still needs patterns and sidelobes rather than assuming omnidirectional gain.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 序列式波束搜尋時間等於候選數乘每次觀測時間；減少候選可能漏掉最佳方向，不能只最小化時間。 展開基準式 64*20；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：列方向索引與接收品質，驗證每個候選恰觀測一次；測試最佳波束不在粗選集合的反例。 將兩條推導一起存入 beam_candidates.csv、掃描時間軸、漏選反例。
從原理 理想相位校準且固定總發射功率時，指向增益相對單元為10log10N；固定每元功率是不同基準。 展開基準式 10*log10(16)；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：每單元功率分別1/16及1/64 W；用場振幅相加再平方驗證總功率基準。 將兩條推導一起存入 array_power.csv、正規化推導、相位誤差圖。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Sequential beam-search duration is candidate count times observation time; fewer candidates may miss the best direction., expand baseline expression 64*20; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: List direction IDs and quality, observing each once; include a counterexample whose optimum lies outside the shortlist. Save both derivations with beam_candidates.csv, sweep timeline and shortlist counterexample.

Starting from With ideal phase calibration and fixed total transmitted power, directional gain is10log10N relative to one element; fixed per-element power is a different comparison., expand baseline expression 10*log10(16); record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Per-element powers are1/16 and1/64 W; add field amplitudes and square to verify the normalization. Save both derivations with array_power.csv, normalization derivation and phase-error plot.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IEEE 802.11ac MU-MIMO：同時傳送與慢使用者
related.titleEn: IEEE802.11ac MU-MIMO: concurrency and a slow user
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付物能重現 1280 microsecond 與 320 microsecond，保留失敗情境且每個通過判定有明確門檻；需分開列出模型未涵蓋的實際系統驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: The artifacts must reproduce 1280 microsecond and 320 microsecond, preserve failing scenarios and attach a threshold to each pass decision; list actual-system validation outside this model separately.
related.difference: 能推導並解釋30 ms與20 ms，建立mu_mimo_schedule.csv、使用者時間線、CSI品質，並完成以下驗收：25 ms交付目標只有理想同時組通過；加入探測與填補後必須重新檢查。
related.differenceEn: Derive and explain 30 ms and 20 ms; create mu_mimo_schedule.csv, user timelines and CSI quality; apply this acceptance decision: Only ideal concurrent service meets25 ms; recheck after sounding and padding overhead.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從原理 序列式波束搜尋時間等於候選數乘每次觀測時間；減少候選可能漏掉最佳方向，不能只最小化時間。 展開基準式 64*20；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：列方向索引與接收品質，驗證每個候選恰觀測一次；測試最佳波束不在粗選集合的反例。 將兩條推導一起存入 beam_candidates.csv、掃描時間軸、漏選反例。
從原理 同時排程時完成時間由最慢流決定；理想空間分離不保證實際通道正交。 展開基準式 1/100*1000+1/50*1000；逐步記錄中間量與單位，先手算再用計算器或Python重算。接著用不同表示法交叉檢查：畫兩條服務時間線10與20 ms；循序相加、同時取最大，不可把速率直接相加後除總位元。 將兩條推導一起存入 mu_mimo_schedule.csv、使用者時間線、CSI品質。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Starting from Sequential beam-search duration is candidate count times observation time; fewer candidates may miss the best direction., expand baseline expression 64*20; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: List direction IDs and quality, observing each once; include a counterexample whose optimum lies outside the shortlist. Save both derivations with beam_candidates.csv, sweep timeline and shortlist counterexample.

Starting from Concurrent completion is governed by the slowest stream; ideal spatial separation does not guarantee actual channel orthogonality., expand baseline expression 1/100*1000+1/50*1000; record intermediate values and units, calculate manually, then repeat with a calculator or Python. Use this independent representation: Draw10/20 ms service timelines; sequential sums, concurrent takes the maximum rather than dividing total bits by a sum of rates. Save both derivations with mu_mimo_schedule.csv, user timelines and CSI quality.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
